name: Create React App
message: Create React App is officially deprecated (2023)
replacement: Vite, Next.js, Remix, or another supported React framework

name: Moment.js
message: Moment.js is in maintenance mode — consider date-fns or dayjs
replacement: date-fns, Day.js, Luxon, or Intl APIs

name: TSLint
message: TSLint is deprecated — use ESLint with TypeScript support

name: jQuery
message: jQuery usage may indicate outdated stack for modern apps
replacement: Modern DOM APIs or framework-native patterns

name: AngularJS
replacement: Angular, React, Vue, or another supported frontend framework

name: Webpack 2/3/4
replacement: Webpack 5, Vite, or another supported bundler

name: Node.js EOL LTS
message: Node.js version is EOL — upgrade to current LTS

name: Internet Explorer
message: Internet Explorer is EOL since June 2022

name: Adobe Flash
message: Adobe Flash reached EOL in December 2020
replacement: HTML5, Web APIs, or native browser media capabilities

name: PHP 5/7
message: PHP 5.x / 7.x may be EOL — PHP 8.x is current

name: Heroku Free
replacement: Paid Heroku dynos or another supported hosting tier

name: Travis CI
message: Travis CI free tier was removed — consider GitHub Actions
replacement: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, or another maintained CI provider

name: Bootstrap 2/3
message: Bootstrap 2/3 is EOL — Bootstrap 5 is current
replacement: Bootstrap 5 or another supported UI framework
